description: Windows LAN test package for ESC/POS thermal printers over TCP 9100 (same dialect as DantSu Android).

steps: Unzip on a Windows PC on the same LAN as the printer.
Run Test-BisyncPrinter.cmd (or the PowerShell script) with the printer IP.
In Bisync Device set up, bind the printer with SDK escpos-lan-windows, then use Android DantSu on the tablet for production printing.
